findings.claim: The bare-to-absolute upgrade might discard owner members. Refuted: owns() (opencode_json.go:63-80) requires canonical equality with our entry after normalizing the command, so an entry with any extra member is foreign and never upgraded.
An empty object at column 0 gets two-space indent in a tab file. Answered: there is no sibling to read the style from; two spaces is the documented fallback.
